question: On GENCO's PUBLISHED pretraining data (9 affected subgrids), does datakit's fast path (compute_ac_pf, default trust-region, flat start, inputs rebuilt from the published raw tables) reproduce the published collapsed label, and does method=:newton reach our physical root?
sample: up to 6 collapsed scenarios per subgrid (evenly spaced among relabeled.csv recovered rows with label_reason min_vm_below_0.5 or negative_vm) + 1 healthy control per subgrid
reproduces_label: trust_region converged and max |dV| vs published label < 1e-6 pu
newton_physical: newton converged and max |dV| vs our corrected root < 1e-4 pu (as probe_newton.jl in 2026-10-10-datakit-collapse-cause)
report: counts per subgrid; no scenario dropped; julia errors reported as such
limits_known_in_advance: input rebuild assumes the published raw tables hold datakit's exact PF input (true on our ladder grids to 1e-13); the published data's generator version is not known
